topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon it quite by accident, flipping through the school's online repository, a digital echo of my noodling thoughts from a year ago, my college essay, right there in public view. It was supposed to be a private musing, a snapshot of who I was, a fragment of my being laid bare on the page. Now anyone can read it, dissect it, perhaps even mock it. I should have chosen my words more carefully, fortified my sentences against the glare of strangers’ eyes. I wonder what they think, where I went, if they see in my words the same turmoil I do. I wish I could retract it, reshape it, but it’s out there now, a part of me immortalized in a way I hadn’t imagined.
